maria_g: Quick heads-up — planning a micro-cohort canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC for the pricing-search model. Target cohort = EU-west-2, "small-tenant" slice (~1.2% traffic). ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m steps if signals good. Who's owning the kick and smoke?
cheng_li: I can kick and monitor. I'll be oncall 09:30-11:30 UTC.
ops_oncall: I'll shadow from the SRE side for metrics/alerts. Can we list the smoke checks so we have a checklist? :clipboard:
maria_g: Smoke checklist: 1) /health returns 200 for 10 sample hosts, 2) p50/p95 token latency under 300/800ms, 3) error rate < 0.1%, 4) synthetic prompt evals (sample prompt set) pass. Also watch for KV cache miss spike.
sam_h: Add a quick query to confirm routing: `curl -sS -H "X-Canary: small-tenant" https://api.redwood.example/predict | jq '.model_version'` — should return `v2026.02-canary`.
priya_s: Rollback plan in case of noise: immediate rollback to `v2026.01` and open a rollback ticket. Auto-fallback policy already set to downgrade to smaller quantized variant if latency breaches.
maria_g: Good. I'll create the release wedge in the console now and schedule the cohort. Cheng — start the cohort at 10:00, hold 30m between steps, call it if any smoke fails. Ops — monitor prometheus dashboards + tracing for slow spans.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment job #deploy-4789 for 2026-04-12T10:00:00Z created by maria_g. Canary slices: eu-west-2/small-tenant. Stages: 1%,5%,20%. Notifications: #eng-releases + oncall.
cheng_li: A couple of operational notes: 1) I'll run the smoke script in `infra/deploy/smoke.sh` after the first 1% bump. 2) If p95 > 1s for 2 consecutive 1m buckets we rollback.
priya_s: Where is the smoke script? Can you paste the commands you'll run?
cheng_li: Sure — basic run: ```
./infra/deploy/smoke.sh --env eu-west-2 --cohort small-tenant --checks health,latency,evals
# fallback rollback cmd (manual): rcli rollback --service pricing-search --tag v2026.01
```
maria_g: Perfect. I'll post the canary ticket with checklist and ping here 09:45 UTC for final go/no-go. If anyone wants ownership of the 5% -> 20% step, say now.
sam_h: I'll take 5% -> 20% handoff and watch the cost/throughput signals. :thumbsup:
ops_oncall: I'll stay until 11:30 and then hand to next oncall. Leaving alerts as-is with runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-smoke.
priya_s: Confirming rollback automation is armed (monitoring -> runbooks triggers) and runbook has the `rcli` snippet.
maria_g: Thanks all — see you tomorrow 10:00 UTC. If anything changes I'll update this thread. :wave:
